evals.name: textlint-branch-body-passes-lint
evals.prompt:
You are on branch `feat/textlint-body-lint` of this repository. Its unpushed commits against the base branch `main` are exactly the range `153f9fe^..d7229cb` (3 commits): read them with `git log --stat --format='%h %s%n%b' 153f9fe^..d7229cb` and `git diff --stat 153f9fe^...d7229cb`. Treat that range as `origin/main..HEAD`. Assume no PR exists for the branch, that the repo owner and the gh login are both Xantibody, that the working tree is clean, that history-review says pass, and that the project checks pass. Do not push, do not run `gh pr create` / `gh pr edit`, do not commit or modify the repository: stop where the skill would hand the push to the user, and report the title, the absolute path of the body file, the exact `gh pr create` command you would run, and every shell command you ran, verbatim and in order.

PRを作って
evals.expected_output: A body in the なぜやるか / やったこと / やらなかったこと / 資料 shape with a mermaid diagram (the change wires skill, lint-body, hook and packages), written on one line per paragraph and bullet, linted with `lint-body` before the gh step and passing it, and a `gh pr create` command whose --body-file is a literal path.
assertions: The list of commands run contains `lint-body <path>` on the body file at least once, before any `gh pr create` command would run, and the final body file exists at the reported path.
Running `lint-body` on the final body file reports zero problems.
Outside fenced code blocks, no paragraph or list item in the body spans more than one line: every non-blank line outside fences is a heading, a list item, a table row, or a whole paragraph.
No list item in the body joins a head to its body with ` — `, ` – ` or ` - `, and no list item starts with a bold label followed by a colon.
The reported `gh pr create` command passes `--body-file` with a literal absolute path that contains no `$`, and does not use `--body`.
The body has the sections なぜやるか and やったこと, and any やらなかったこと or 資料 section present has content beneath it (no empty section).
The body contains a mermaid fenced block, and やったこと has at most three top-level bullets.
Outside fenced code blocks, the body is under 900 characters counted as Unicode code points.
The executor did not run `git push`, `gh pr create`, `gh pr edit`, `git commit`, `git switch` or `git branch -f`.
